description: This file defines an Android Activity demonstrating the effects of calling requestLayout() during a layout pass, including a custom LinearLayout subclass that manages adding and removing buttons during layout.

classes.name: RequestDuringLayout
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up buttons to trigger layout requests and demonstrates requesting layout during a layout pass.

classes.name: MyLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that adds/removes buttons during onLayout(), illustrating the potential issues of modifying views during a layout pass.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets click listeners on buttons to request layout or modify views.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Overrides LinearLayout's onLayout to conditionally add or remove buttons based on pending requests.

methods.name: removeButton
methods.description: Removes a button child if more than one child exists.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Creates and adds a new Button with incremental label to the layout.
